statement: China's shale oil extraction will not reach significant levels due to technical limitations and geopolitical risks.
transcript_excerpt: So only about 5% of the wells that the Chinese have drilled at this point even remotely approach break even… they've steadily revised down their estimates. I think they're now down to less than 2% of what they thought they were to get 15 years ago.
